post.description:
Session tokens (login exchange; the CLI's device and refresh grants) and the `job`
grant (form-encoded).

Revoke a job token when its job ends or is cancelled, or sign a CLI login out
(`token=<job token>` or `token=lr_…`, RFC 7009 form).

The token authenticates the request itself: its holder may end it. `200` when revoked,
already revoked or already expired.
Email a one-time sign-in code; `202` whether or not the email is known.
Sign in with the emailed code (a new email becomes a new user).
Sign in with a password; an unverified email answers `403` and gets a code.
Create a password user; answers `403 email-verification-required` with the code sent.
Finish a login held for email verification with the emailed code.
Email a reset link to `<app>/reset-password?token=…`; `202` whether or not the email is known.
Set a new password with the emailed token.

post.description: Finish a social login with the returned code.
New AuthKit tokens for a live session; `401 login-refused` when it ended.
Start the CLI's device flow (RFC 8628 §3.1; form-encoded, no client authentication).
